items.title: 基数词与序数词的形式
items.brief: 序数词只变个位，整十改 y 为 ie 再加 th

concept.summary: 序数词的变形只发生在个位：1–3 为 first/second/third，4 起加 -th，整十把 y 变成 ie 再加 th，两位数以上只把个位改成序数词。基数词 21–99 的十位与个位之间必须用连字符，百位与十位之间英式英语加 and。序数词前一般用 the，表示“又一次”时改用 a。

sections.h: 序数词的四条变形路径
sections.p: 先判断这个数字落在哪一段，再决定变形方式。整十词与合成数词最容易出错，因为学生常把 -th 加在整个词尾。
bullets: 1–3：first, second, third，必须整记
4–19 加 th：fourth, sixth, seventh；fifth 由 five 变 ve 为 f，eighth 只加 h，ninth 去 e，twelfth 由 twelve 变 ve 为 f
整十：y 变 ie 再加 th，twentieth, thirtieth, fortieth, ninetieth
两位数以上只变个位：twenty-first, thirty-second, one hundred and first

sections.h: 基数词的连字符与 and
sections.p: 基数词的书写规则只有两条：十位与个位之间用连字符，百位与十位之间英式英语用 and。千位以上按三位一组，书面语中可加逗号。
bullets: twenty-one, ninety-nine：十位与个位之间的连字符不能省
one hundred and twenty-three：and 只出现在百位与后面的数之间
2,500 读作 two thousand five hundred，hundred 后不加 s

sections.p: 序数词缩写由词尾两个字母决定，与数字大小无关。序数词前的冠词取决于是否指确定顺序：指顺序用 the，表示“再一个”用 a。
bullets: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th；21st, 22nd, 23rd, 24th
the second chapter 指第二章；a second chapter 指又一个章节
the twenty-first century 中的 the 不能省

examples.en: She lives on the twelfth floor of that building.
examples.zh: 她住在那栋楼的十二层。
examples.note: twelve 变序数词时把 ve 改成 f 再加 th。

examples.en: She lives on the twelveth floor of that building.
examples.zh: 她住在那栋楼的十二层。
examples.note: twelve 不能直接加 th，正确形式是 twelfth。

examples.en: This is my twenty-first birthday.
examples.zh: 这是我二十一岁生日。
examples.note: 两位数只把个位 one 改成 first，十位 twenty 不变。

examples.en: Our seats are in the twenty-second row.
examples.zh: 我们的座位在第二十二排。
examples.note: twenty-two 变序数词只改个位，构成 twenty-second。

examples.en: A third attempt was needed before the machine started.
examples.zh: 机器启动前又试了一次。
examples.note: a + 序数词表示“又一次”，不表示确定顺序。

examples.en: He was the fourty-second runner to cross the line.
examples.zh: 他是第四十二个冲过终点线的选手。
examples.note: forty 的拼写不含 u，应为 forty-second。

pitfalls.wrong: My office is on the nineth floor.
pitfalls.right: My office is on the ninth floor.
pitfalls.why: nine 变序数词要去掉词尾的 e 再加 th，不能保留 e 直接拼 th。

pitfalls.wrong: She was the twentyth customer of the day.
pitfalls.right: She was the twentieth customer of the day.
pitfalls.why: 整十的序数词要把 y 变成 ie 再加 th，不能只加 th。

pitfalls.wrong: There are twenty one students in the room.
pitfalls.right: There are twenty-one students in the room.
pitfalls.why: 21–99 的十位与个位之间必须用连字符连接，这是一个书写单位。

contrast.withTitle: 分数、小数与百分数的表达
contrast.diff: 序数词单独使用表示顺序；分数借用序数词表示分母，分子大于 1 时分母还要加 s。

concept.mnemonic: 一二三特殊记，四起加 th；整十 y 变 ie，几十几只变个位。

core: 1–3：first, second, third，无规律，整记
4–19 加 th，fifth / eighth / ninth / twelfth 拼写特殊
整十 y 变 ie 再加 th：twentieth, fortieth
两位数以上只变个位：twenty-first, one hundred and first
指顺序用 the，表“又一次”用 a second
review.trigger: 看到“第几”要写英文 → 先看是否整十 → 再只改个位 → 最后检查用 the 还是 a

quickCheck.a: twelfth，twelve 的 ve 改成 f 再加 th。
twenty-first，只把个位 one 变成 first。

quickCheck.q: a second try 与 the second try 有何不同？
quickCheck.a: 前者是“又一次尝试”，后者是“第二次尝试”。

drills.stem: The reading room is on the ___ floor of the library.
drills.explain: twelve 变序数词时把词尾 ve 改成 f 再加 th，构成 twelfth，用作定语修饰 floor。
drills.trap: twelveth 是把 th 直接加在 twelve 后面的拼写错误，没有处理 ve 的变化。

drills.stem: Our new office is on the ___ (twenty-one) floor of the tower.
drills.hint: 两位数变序数词只改个位。
drills.explain: twenty-one 变序数词时十位 twenty 保持不变，只把个位 one 改成 first，并用连字符连接。

drills.stem: She was the fourty-second runner to reach the finish line.
drills.answer: She was the forty-second runner to reach the finish line.
accept: She was the forty-second runner to reach the finish line.
drills.explain: forty 的拼写是 f-o-r-t-y，不含 u；序数词部分只改个位 two 为 second。

drills.stem: He failed twice, but he decided to make ___ attempt.
drills.explain: a + 序数词表示“再一个、又一次”，此处指第三次尝试，不强调确定顺序，因此用 a third。
drills.trap: the third 强调顺序上的第三次，与“再试一次”的语义不符。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.explain: twenty-first 为序数词，修饰 birthday；物主代词 my 已限定名词，不再加 the。

drills.stem: 他住在十二楼。
drills.answer: He lives on the twelfth floor.
drills.explain: 楼层用序数词，twelve 变 twelfth 时 ve 改 f 再加 th，且序数词前要用 the。

items.title: 分数、小数与百分数的表达
items.brief: 分子基数分母序数，percent 永不加 s

concept.summary: 分数用“分子基数词 + 分母序数词”，分子大于 1 时分母加 s；小数按位逐个读，小数点读 point；百分数用 percent，单复数同形。分数或百分数作主语时，谓语与 of 后面的名词一致，而不与前面的数字一致。

sections.p: 分母是序数词，分子是基数词。分子为 1 时分母用单数，分子大于 1 时分母必须加 s。几个高频分数有固定说法，写作中优先使用。
bullets: 1/3 one third；2/3 two thirds；3/4 three quarters
1/2 a half；1/4 a quarter；1/4 也可说 one fourth
带分数：one and a half、two and three quarters，后面接复数名词
分子大于 1 → 分母加 s：two fifths, three tenths

sections.p: 小数点读作 point，小数点后的数字一位一位读，不按整数读法合并。percent 是固定形式，前面无论是什么数字都不加 s。
bullets: 3.14 读作 three point one four，不读 three point fourteen
0.5 读作 zero point five，也可省略 zero 说 point five
30 percent、5 percent：percent 单复数同形
升降幅度用 by：rise by 5 percent

sections.p: 分数与百分数只是修饰语，真正决定谓语的是 of 后面的名词。of 后是不可数名词或单数名词，谓语用单数；of 后是复数名词，谓语用复数。
bullets: Two thirds of the land is covered with forest.
Two thirds of the students are from the countryside.
Seventy percent of the water was wasted.

examples.en: Two thirds of the earth's surface is covered with water.
examples.zh: 地球表面三分之二被水覆盖。
examples.note: 分子 2 大于 1，分母用 thirds；谓语与不可数 surface 一致用 is。

examples.en: Two third of the earth's surface is covered with water.
examples.zh: 地球表面三分之二被水覆盖。
examples.note: 分子大于 1 时分母必须加 s，应为 two thirds。

examples.en: Nearly seventy percent of the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 将近百分之七十的学生通过了考试。
examples.note: percent 不加 s；谓语与复数 students 一致用 passed。

examples.en: Nearly seventy percents of the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 将近百分之七十的学生通过了考试。
examples.note: percent 单复数同形，永远不加 s。

examples.en: The price of the apartment has risen by 5 percent this year.
examples.zh: 今年公寓价格上涨了百分之五。
examples.note: by + 百分数表示升降幅度，percent 用单数形式。

examples.en: Add one and a half cups of milk to the flour.
examples.zh: 往面粉里加一杯半牛奶。
examples.note: 带分数超过 1，后面的名词用复数 cups。

examples.en: Add one and a half cup of milk to the flour.
examples.zh: 往面粉里加一杯半牛奶。
examples.note: 数量超过 1，可数名词必须用复数，应为 cups。

pitfalls.wrong: Three fourth of the members were absent.
pitfalls.right: Three fourths of the members were absent.
pitfalls.why: 分子 3 大于 1，分母序数词必须加 s 表示复数。

pitfalls.wrong: Twenty percents of the land is desert.
pitfalls.right: Twenty percent of the land is desert.
pitfalls.why: percent 是固定形式，不随前面的数字变复数。

pitfalls.wrong: One and a half hour is enough for the trip.
pitfalls.right: One and a half hours are enough for the trip.
pitfalls.why: 数量超过 1，名词用复数，谓语也随之用复数。

contrast.diff: 分数表示部分与整体的比例，谓语看 of 后的名词；倍数表示两个量的比较结果，用 times 或 twice 并搭配 as...as 或 the size of。

concept.mnemonic: 分子基数分母序，分子过一分母加 s；percent 永远不加 s。

core: 分数 = 分子基数词 + 分母序数词：two thirds
1/2 a half；1/4 a quarter；3/4 three quarters
小数逐位读，小数点读 point：3.14 = three point one four
percent 单复数同形，不加 s，不随数字变化
分数、百分数作主语，谓语与 of 后的名词一致
review.trigger: 看到分数或百分数作主语 → 先看 of 后面名词的单复数 → 再定谓语

quickCheck.q: Fifty percent of the water ___ polluted. 填什么？
quickCheck.a: is，谓语与不可数名词 water 一致。

drills.stem: About ___ of the surface of the earth is covered by water.
drills.explain: 分子 two 用基数词，分母 three 用序数词；分子大于 1，分母要加 s，构成 two thirds。
drills.trap: two third 漏掉了分母的复数 s，是最常见的分数写法错误。

drills.stem: Two ___ (three) of the members were absent from the meeting.
drills.hint: 分子是 two，分母要用序数词的复数形式。
drills.explain: two 大于 1，分母 third 必须加 s 变成 thirds；谓语 were 也与复数主语一致。

drills.stem: Seventy percents of the water in the lake has been polluted.
drills.answer: Seventy percent of the water in the lake has been polluted.
accept: Seventy percent of the water in the lake has been polluted.
drills.explain: percent 单复数同形，不能加 s；谓语 has 与不可数名词 water 一致，本身正确。

drills.stem: The number 0.25 is read as ___.
drills.explain: 小数点读 point，小数点后的每一位数字单独读出，0.25 即 zero point two five。
drills.trap: zero point twenty-five 把小数部分当成整数读，英语中小数点后必须逐位读。

drills.stem: 我们学校三分之二的学生住在校内。
drills.answer: Two thirds of the students in our school live on campus.
drills.explain: 分子 two 大于 1，分母用 thirds；谓语与复数 students 一致，用 live 而不是 lives。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: Two thirds of the land is desert.
drills.explain: 分数作主语时谓语看 of 后的名词，land 不可数，谓语用 is。

items.title: 倍数表达法
items.brief: 倍数放最前，配 as...as、比较级或 the size of

concept.summary: 倍数有三种句式：倍数 + as + 原级 + as；倍数 + 比较级 + than；倍数 + the + 名词（size/length/weight/height）+ of。倍数词一律位于第一个比较结构之前，句中不再叠加 more。第三种句式必须把形容词换成对应的名词，这是最易错的一步。

sections.p: 同一组比较可以用三种句式表达，意思相同但结构不同。做题时先看句子里已经给出的是 as、than 还是 the + 名词，再补倍数词。
bullets: A is three times as long as B.
A is three times longer than B.（教材与考试中视为同义）
A is three times the length of B.
第三种句式中的 length 不能换回 long：× three times the long of

sections.p: 倍数用 once, twice, three times...；表示“是……的两倍”只能用 twice，不能用 two times 之外的 once。涉及名词时按可数性选 many 或 much。
bullets: twice as many books as；twice as much water as
half as expensive as（一半的价钱）
倍数词放在第一个 as 或比较级之前，不能放在句末

sections.p: 动词 double、triple 本身已含倍数义，后面不再加 times。increase by 后接百分数表示增幅，与“是几倍”不是同一表达。
bullets: The company's profits doubled last year.
Output has tripled since 2010.
Sales rose by 40 percent, not by 40 times.

examples.en: This bridge is three times as long as that one.
examples.zh: 这座桥是那座桥的三倍长。
examples.note: 倍数 three times 放在第一个 as 之前，as 与 as 之间用原级 long。

examples.en: The new library is four times the size of the old one.
examples.zh: 新图书馆的面积是旧馆的四倍。
examples.note: 第三种句式用 the size of，形容词 large 已换成名词 size。

examples.en: The population of the city is now twice what it was in 2000.
examples.zh: 这座城市的人口现在是 2000 年的两倍。
examples.note: twice 后接 what 从句，表示“是……的两倍”。

examples.en: This room is three times as larger as that one.
examples.zh: 这个房间是那个房间的三倍大。
examples.note: as...as 之间必须用原级，larger 应改为 large。

examples.en: This road is three times the long of that one.
examples.zh: 这条路是那条路的三倍长。
examples.note: the 后面要接名词，long 应改为 length。

examples.en: The company's profits doubled last year.
examples.zh: 公司去年的利润翻了一番。
examples.note: double 作动词本身表示“变成两倍”，不再加 times。

examples.en: This box is twice as heavy as that one.
examples.zh: 这个箱子是那个箱子的两倍重。
examples.note: 两倍只能用 twice，结构为 twice as + 原级 + as。

pitfalls.wrong: This room is three times as larger as that one.
pitfalls.right: This room is three times as large as that one.
pitfalls.why: as...as 是同级比较框架，中间只能放原级，比较级与它冲突。

pitfalls.wrong: The river is twice the long of that stream.
pitfalls.right: The river is twice the length of that stream.
pitfalls.why: the 后必须是名词，表示长度的名词是 length，不能直接用形容词 long。

pitfalls.wrong: The price is three times as high than before.
pitfalls.right: The price is three times as high as before.
pitfalls.why: as 必须与 as 配对，than 只用于比较级结构。

contrast.diff: 倍数词回答“几倍”，修饰语（much/far/even）回答“差距多大”；两者都放在比较结构前，但功能不同，不能互相替代。

concept.mnemonic: 倍数永远站最前；as...as 用原级，the 后一定接名词。

core: 句式一：倍数 + as + 原级 + as
句式二：倍数 + 比较级 + than
句式三：倍数 + the + 名词（size/length/weight）+ of
倍数词放最前：twice, three times, four times
可数用 as many，不可数用 as much；翻倍用 double
review.trigger: 看到“是……的几倍” → 先看句中给的是 as、than 还是 the → 再补倍数词并核对词性

quickCheck.a: three times as long as、three times longer than、three times the length of。

quickCheck.q: as...as 中间能放比较级吗？

drills.stem: The new stadium is almost three times ___ the old one.
drills.explain: three times 后接同级比较结构 as + 原级 + as，因此是 as large as。
drills.trap: as larger as 在 as...as 框架中误用了比较级，是最高频的倍数错误。

drills.stem: The new bridge is three times the ___ (long) of the old one.
drills.hint: the 后面需要名词，不能填形容词。
drills.explain: 第三种倍数句式为 倍数 + the + 名词 + of，long 对应的名词是 length。

drills.stem: This suitcase is twice as heavier as that one.
drills.answer: This suitcase is twice as heavy as that one.
accept: This suitcase is twice as heavy as that one.
drills.explain: as...as 之间必须用形容词原级，heavier 应改为 heavy；倍数 twice 位置正确。

drills.stem: 这间教室是那间的两倍大。
drills.answer: This classroom is twice as large as that one.
drills.explain: 两倍用 twice，后接 as + 原级 + as；不能把 twice 与比较级或 than 混搭。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The new road is three times as wide as the old one.
drills.explain: 倍数 three times 置于第一个 as 之前，as 与 as 之间用原级 wide。

drills.stem: The company's profits ___ last year, from two million to four million dollars.
drills.explain: 从两百万到四百万是“翻倍”，用动词 double 的过去式 doubled 作谓语。
drills.trap: twice 是限定词或副词，不能单独作谓语；doubled up 意为“笑弯了腰”，与数字无关。

items.title: 年代、世纪与年龄的表达
items.brief: 年代补 the 与 s，年龄用 one's 加复数

concept.summary: 年代写作 in the 1990s，the 与词尾的 s 都不能省；世纪用序数词 + century，即 in the 21st century；年龄的区间用 in one's thirties，必须用所有格加整十复数。年份按两位一组读，2000 年之后的年份也可读作 two thousand and eight。

sections.p: 年代是“十年”这一整体，形式上必须是 the + 年份 + s；世纪是“第几个一百年”，形式上必须是序数词 + century。两种结构都带定冠词，不能省略。
bullets: in the 1980s = in the eighties，指 1980 至 1989
in the 1990s 不能写成 in 1990s
in the 21st century = in the twenty-first century
the early / late 1990s 表示该年代的前期或后期

sections.p: 具体年龄用基数词，年龄段用整十词的复数并加所有格。作定语时改用带连字符的复合形容词，这一点与数词作定语的规则一致。
bullets: at the age of ten；a boy of ten；aged ten
in his early thirties 表示三十出头
a ten-year-old boy 作前置定语，year 用单数
in one's forties 中的 one's 随主语变化：in her forties

sections.p: 四位年份通常拆成两个两位数来读，中间有 0 的年份读作 oh。2000 年后的年份既可以按两位数读，也可以按千位读，两种都成立。
bullets: 1998 → nineteen ninety-eight
1805 → eighteen oh five
2008 → two thousand and eight
2020 → twenty twenty 或 two thousand and twenty

examples.en: The factory was built in the 1980s.
examples.zh: 这家工厂建于二十世纪八十年代。
examples.note: 年代结构为 the + 年份 + s，the 与 s 都不能省。

examples.en: The factory was built in 1980s.
examples.zh: 这家工厂建于二十世纪八十年代。
examples.note: 年代前必须有定冠词 the，应为 in the 1980s。

examples.en: She started learning the piano in her forties.
examples.zh: 她四十多岁时开始学钢琴。
examples.note: 年龄段用 in + 所有格 + 整十复数，forties 表四十多岁。

examples.en: She started learning the piano in her forty.
examples.zh: 她四十多岁时开始学钢琴。
examples.note: 年龄段必须用整十词的复数形式 forties，不能用基数词 forty。

examples.en: The castle dates back to the twelfth century.
examples.zh: 这座城堡可追溯到十二世纪。
examples.note: 世纪用序数词 + century，twelfth 表第十二个一百年。

examples.en: The castle dates back to the twelve century.
examples.zh: 这座城堡可追溯到十二世纪。
examples.note: 世纪必须用序数词，twelve 应改为 twelfth。

examples.en: He published his first novel at the age of twenty-three.
examples.zh: 他二十三岁时出版了第一部小说。
examples.note: at the age of 后接基数词，表具体年龄。

pitfalls.wrong: He made his first million in his thirty.
pitfalls.right: He made his first million in his thirties.
pitfalls.why: 年龄段表示“三十多岁”这一段区间，必须用整十词的复数加所有格。

pitfalls.right: The war broke out in the 1940s.
pitfalls.why: 年代是特指的一段十年，结构固定为 the + 年份复数，缺 the 即错。

pitfalls.wrong: She was born in the twenty-one century.
pitfalls.right: She was born in the twenty-first century.
pitfalls.why: 世纪用序数词而非基数词，twenty-one 应改为 twenty-first。

contrast.withTitle: 基数词与序数词的形式
contrast.diff: 那一节点处理序数词本身的拼写规则；这里只处理年份、世纪、年龄三个固定格式中该用基数还是序数、该不该加 the 与 s。

concept.mnemonic: 年代 the 加 s，世纪用序数，年龄 in one's 加复数。

core: 年代：in the 1990s，the 与 s 都不能省
世纪：in the 21st century = in the twenty-first century
年龄段：in his thirties / in her early forties
具体年龄：at the age of ten / a boy of ten / a ten-year-old boy
年份读法：1998 nineteen ninety-eight；2008 two thousand and eight
review.trigger: 看到年代、世纪或年龄段 → 先补 the 或所有格 → 再检查 s 与序数词是否到位

quickCheck.q: “在二十世纪九十年代”怎么说？
二十一世纪用基数词还是序数词？

drills.stem: The old theatre was pulled down in ___.
drills.explain: 年代结构固定为 the + 年份复数，the 与 s 缺一不可，故用 the 1990s。
drills.trap: 1990s 缺定冠词，年代是特指的一段十年，必须加 the。

drills.stem: My grandfather learned to use a computer in his ___ (sixty).
drills.hint: 年龄段用 in one's + 整十词的复数。
drills.explain: in his sixties 表示“六十多岁”，整十词 sixty 要变复数 sixties 并与所有格 his 搭配。

drills.stem: The bridge was completed in the twenty century.
drills.answer: The bridge was completed in the twentieth century.
accept: The bridge was completed in the twentieth century.
drills.explain: 世纪用序数词而非基数词，twenty 应改为 twentieth，结构为 the + 序数词 + century。

drills.stem: The famous writer produced most of his best work in his ___.
drills.explain: in one's thirties 是固定结构，用整十词的复数表示“三十多岁”这一区间。
drills.trap: thirty 是基数词，只能指确定的三十，无法表达年龄段。

drills.stem: 这座教堂建于十九世纪。
drills.answer: The church was built in the nineteenth century.
drills.explain: 世纪用序数词 + century，nineteen 应变为 nineteenth，且 century 用单数。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: She wrote her first novel at the age of twenty-three.
drills.explain: at the age of 后接基数词表示具体年龄，twenty-three 不再变成序数词。

items.title: 数词作定语的单复数
items.brief: 连字符里不带 s，分数分母除外

concept.summary: 数词与名词组成复合定语修饰后面的名词时，内部名词一律用单数，各成分之间加连字符：a five-year plan、a ten-year-old boy。只有分数作定语保留分母的复数（a two-thirds majority）。一旦该数量改到名词后作表语或后置修饰，名词恢复复数并去掉连字符。

sections.p: 复合定语是一个整体形容词，内部的数词与名词都不再独立计数。中心名词是单数还是复数，不影响内部形式。
bullets: a five-year plan；a two-hour meeting
a 200-metre bridge；a six-foot man
a ten-year-old girl = a girl of ten years old
中心名词变复数时内部不变：two five-year plans

sections.p: 分数作定语时分子与分母都保留，分子大于 1 分母仍加 s，因为这里保留的是分数本身的完整形式；percent 作定语依旧不加 s。
bullets: a two-thirds majority（三分之二多数）
a 5 percent increase（百分之五的增长）
a half-hour walk（半小时的步行）

sections.p: 同一个数量放在名词前要压缩成单数加连字符，放在名词后则恢复正常数量短语。判断依据是它有没有紧贴名词作定语。
bullets: a three-hour journey = a journey of three hours
a ten-year-old boy = a boy of ten
a six-foot man = a man of six feet

examples.en: They carried out a five-year study on urban air quality.
examples.zh: 他们开展了一项为期五年的城市空气质量研究。
examples.note: five-year 作前置定语，year 用单数并加连字符。

examples.en: They carried out a five-years study on urban air quality.
examples.zh: 他们开展了一项为期五年的城市空气质量研究。
examples.note: 复合定语内部的名词必须用单数，five-years 应改为 five-year。

examples.en: He is a ten-year-old boy with a gift for music.
examples.zh: 他是个有音乐天赋的十岁男孩。
examples.note: 数词 + 名词 + 形容词构成复合定语，三个成分用连字符连接。

examples.en: He is a ten-years-old boy with a gift for music.
examples.zh: 他是个有音乐天赋的十岁男孩。
examples.note: 复合定语内部的 year 不能加 s，应为 ten-year-old。

examples.en: The motion was passed by a two-thirds majority.
examples.zh: 这项动议以三分之二多数通过。
examples.note: 分数作定语时保留分母的复数形式 thirds。

examples.en: The country recorded a 5 percent growth rate last year.
examples.zh: 该国去年录得百分之五的增长率。
examples.note: 百分数作定语，percent 保持单数形式。

examples.en: The country recorded a 5 percents growth rate last year.
examples.zh: 该国去年录得百分之五的增长率。
examples.note: percent 在复合定语中同样不加 s，应为 5 percent。

pitfalls.wrong: They held a three-hours meeting yesterday.
pitfalls.right: They held a three-hour meeting yesterday.
pitfalls.why: 复合定语内部的名词不承担计数功能，hour 必须用单数。

pitfalls.wrong: The reform won a two-third majority.
pitfalls.right: The reform won a two-thirds majority.
pitfalls.why: 分数作定语时分子大于 1，分母仍要保留复数词尾 s。

pitfalls.wrong: The company reported a 5 percents increase in sales.
pitfalls.right: The company reported a 5 percent increase in sales.
pitfalls.why: percent 单复数同形，作定语时也不加 s。

contrast.diff: 那一节点讨论类别名词作定语要不要加 s；这里专门处理数词参与构成的复合定语，核心是连字符与内部名词单数。

concept.mnemonic: 连字符里不带 s，分数分母是唯一例外。

core: 数词 + 名词作定语：内部名词单数 + 连字符（a five-year plan）
数词 + 名词 + 形容词：a ten-year-old boy
分数作定语保留分母复数：a two-thirds majority
百分数作定语：a 5 percent increase，percent 不加 s
改后置后恢复复数：a journey of three hours
review.trigger: 看到连字符前的数词 → 内部名词一律写单数 → 分数与 percent 单独核对

quickCheck.a: a two-thirds majority，分母保留 s。

drills.stem: The committee approved a ___ plan for the redevelopment of the district.
drills.explain: 数词 + 名词作前置定语时，名词用单数并以连字符连接，构成 five-year。
drills.trap: five years 单独使用是正确的数量短语，但作前置定语必须压缩成单数加连字符。

drills.stem: She is a ___ girl who has already published two novels. (fourteen year old)
drills.hint: 数词、名词、形容词三个成分之间都要加连字符。
drills.explain: 数词 + 名词 + 形容词构成复合定语，内部名词 year 用单数，写作 fourteen-year-old。

drills.stem: The mayor announced a three-years project to repair the old sewers.
drills.answer: The mayor announced a three-year project to repair the old sewers.
accept: The mayor announced a three-year project to repair the old sewers.
drills.explain: three-year 是复合定语，内部名词 year 用单数，不加 s。

drills.stem: The reform was finally passed by a ___ majority.
drills.explain: 分数作定语时分子 two 大于 1，分母 third 保留复数词尾，写作 two-thirds。
drills.trap: two-third 漏掉分母的 s，与分数本身的构成规则冲突。

drills.stem: 他们修建了一条五百米长的隧道。
drills.explain: 复合定语内部的 metre 用单数并加连字符；hundred 前有确数 five 时也不加 s。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He took a ten-minute break between classes.
drills.explain: ten-minute 为复合定语，minute 用单数并加连字符，中心名词 break 才是被数的对象。

items.title: dozen/score/hundred 的复数规则
items.brief: 确数用单数不带 of，概数用复数加 of

concept.summary: hundred/thousand/million/dozen/score 前有确数时用单数、直接修饰名词，不加 of；表示不确定的“成百上千”时用复数加 of。确数后若接 the/these/物主代词等限定词，必须补回 of，表示“其中的……”。score 表 20，scores 只用于概数。

sections.p: 前面出现具体数字时，这些词只是数量单位，形式固定为单数，后面直接跟复数名词。这是判断的第一分支，也是最常考的分支。
bullets: two hundred students；three thousand copies
five dozen eggs；two score years
two million dollars：million 不加 s

sections.p: 没有具体数字、只表示“很多”时，这些词变成复数并必须带 of。两层概数叠加时两部分都用复数。
bullets: hundreds of people；thousands of books
dozens of times；scores of volunteers
hundreds of thousands of visitors

sections.h: 确数 + 限定词：补 of
sections.p: 确数后如果出现 the/these/those/物主代词，说明是从一个确定范围中取出若干，此时必须用 of 连接，结构为 确数 + 复数单位 + of + 限定词。
bullets: two hundred of the students（其中的两百名学生）
three dozen of them（其中的三打）
two hundred students（泛指两百名学生，无 of）

examples.en: Two hundred students signed up for the lecture.
examples.zh: 两百名学生报名参加了讲座。
examples.note: hundred 前有确数 two，用单数并直接修饰名词。

examples.en: Two hundreds students signed up for the lecture.
examples.zh: 两百名学生报名参加了讲座。
examples.note: 确数后 hundred 不能加 s，应为 two hundred students。

examples.en: Hundreds of people gathered outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 数百人聚集在体育场外。
examples.note: 表示不确定的“数百”，用复数 hundreds 并带 of。

examples.en: Hundred of people gathered outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 数百人聚集在体育场外。
examples.note: 概数必须用复数形式 hundreds，且 of 不可省。

examples.en: Two hundred of the students were absent because of the storm.
examples.zh: 学生中有两百人因暴风雨缺席。
examples.note: 确数后接限定词 the，必须用 of 表示“其中的两百名”。

examples.en: She bought three dozen eggs at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市场上买了三打鸡蛋。
examples.note: dozen 前有确数 three，用单数形式，后面直接接名词。

examples.en: She bought three dozens eggs at the market.
examples.zh: 她在市场上买了三打鸡蛋。
examples.note: 确数后 dozen 不加 s，应为 three dozen eggs。

examples.en: Scores of volunteers helped clean the beach.
examples.zh: 数十名志愿者帮忙清理海滩。
examples.note: score 表 20，scores of 表示“数十个”，只用于概数。

pitfalls.wrong: Five hundreds people attended the ceremony.
pitfalls.right: Five hundred people attended the ceremony.
pitfalls.why: 前有确数 five 时 hundred 是数量单位，形式固定为单数。

pitfalls.wrong: Thousands students took part in the survey.
pitfalls.right: Thousands of students took part in the survey.
pitfalls.why: 概数结构是复数单位 + of + 名词，of 不能省略。

pitfalls.wrong: Two millions dollars was raised for the project.
pitfalls.right: Two million dollars was raised for the project.
pitfalls.why: 确数后 million 不加 s；金额作为一个整体，谓语用单数。

contrast.diff: 这一节点处理数量单位自身该用单数还是复数、要不要 of；数词作定语处理的是复合定语中的连字符与名词单数。

concept.mnemonic: 确数单数不带 of，概数复数必带 of；the 一出现，of 补回来。

core: 确数：two hundred students（单数、无 of）
概数：hundreds of students（复数 + of）
确数 + 限定词：two hundred of the students（其中的两百）
dozen / score 同规则：three dozen eggs, dozens of times, scores of people
million 同规则：two million dollars, millions of dollars
review.trigger: 看到 hundred/thousand/million/dozen/score → 先看前面有没有确数 → 有则单数无 of，无则复数加 of

drills.stem: ___ students volunteered to help at the charity event last weekend.
drills.explain: 此处表示不确定的“数百名”，用复数 hundreds 加 of 构成概数结构。
drills.trap: Hundred of 把概数写成单数，概数必须是 hundreds + of。

drills.stem: The museum receives ___ of visitors every summer. (thousand)
drills.hint: 句中没有具体数字，说明表示的是概数。
drills.explain: 没有确数而表示“成千上万”，thousand 要变复数并带 of，构成 thousands of。

drills.stem: Two millions people watched the opening ceremony on television.
drills.answer: Two million people watched the opening ceremony on television.
accept: Two million people watched the opening ceremony on television.
drills.explain: million 前有确数 two，只能用单数形式，不能加 s。

drills.stem: ___ the students in our grade have signed up for the competition.
drills.explain: 确数 two hundred 后接限定词 the，必须用 of 连接，表示“其中的两百名”。
drills.trap: Two hundred 后直接跟 the 缺少 of，只有不接限定词时才能省略 of。

drills.stem: 成百上千的人参加了这次会议。
drills.answer: Hundreds of people attended the meeting.
drills.explain: 概数用 hundreds 加 of 修饰 people；若写成 hundreds people 则丢了 of，结构不成立。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The factory employs two thousand workers.
drills.explain: thousand 前有确数 two，用单数形式并直接修饰 workers，不加 of。
